Res.Caption: Actual Percentage
Res.FullDescription: The Percentage of the Actual Weight/Volume to use for calculation.

Res.Caption: Condition
Res.FullDescription: This Rate Line will only be applied when this Rate Line Condition is true.

Res.Caption: Product
Res.FullDescription: This Rate Line will only be applied when this Warehouse Product appears on the Job.

Res.Caption: Rating Calculator
Res.FullDescription: The calculator to use for this specific Rate Line. Typically this is kept the same as the default calculator specified on the charge code.

Res.Caption: Description
Res.FullDescription: The Description of the Rate Line to appear on the Billing tab and Invoice.

Res.Caption: Local Description
Res.FullDescription: The Local Description of the Rate Line to appear on the Billing tab and Invoice.

Res.Caption: Rounding
Res.FullDescription: The type of Rounding to be applied to the resulting amount.

Res.Caption: Rounding Factor
Res.FullDescription: For Rate Lines with "Custom" Rounding set, this is the factor to which rounding is applied to the resulting charges.

Res.Caption: Is On Pallets
Res.FullDescription: This Rate Line will only be applied when the Job is Palletized.

Res.Caption: Is Job Level Charge
Res.FullDescription: This Rate Line will be calculated against the Job Level amounts rather than the total of individual chargeable measures.

Res.Caption: Override Description
Res.FullDescription: When checked, the Rate Line Description for the Billing tab and Invoice can be overridden.

Res.Caption: Actual Weight/Volume
Res.FullDescription: When checked the Rate Line is calculated using the Actual Weight/Volume amount instead of the Chargeable amount.
